Title: Acid Flask
Name: Acid Flask
Effect: This Alchemy allows the Character to throw any number of packets. Any creature struck by one or more packets takes twenty(20) points of Poison Acid damage.

Title: Acid Wave
Name: Acid Wave
Effect: This Alchemy allows the Character to throw any number of packets. Any creature struck by one or more packets takes thirty(30) points of Poison Acid damage.

Title: Adhesive Splash [Binding]
Name: Adhesive Splash
Effect: This Binding Alchemy allows the Character to throw any number of packets. Any creature struck by one or more packets is affected by a Physical Pin effect preventing any target from moving, or lifting, their right foot though they may still pivot upon it.

Title: Alchemist's Fire
Name: Alchemist's Fire
Effect: This Alchemy allows the Character to throw a packet attack causing ten(10) Poison Fire damage at will. The Character may continue to throw this attack until they die, the current Reset period ends, or use another Alchemy. Each individual packet attack is subject to Disruption but this effect is not. This Alchemy cannot benefit from the effects of any Mutation or ability which modifies the casting of a single Alchemy.

Title: Alchemist's Flask
Name: Alchemist's Flask
Effect: Upon using this Alchemy the Character chooses one of the following damage types; Acid, or Fire. The Character may deliver a packet attack causing ten(10) points of Poison damage of the chosen type.

Title: Alchemist's Flask, Greater
Name: Alchemist's Flask, Greater
Effect: Upon using this Alchemy the Character chooses one of the following damage types; Acid, or Fire. The Character may deliver a packet attack causing thirty(30) points of Poison damage of the chosen type.

Title: Anaesthetize [Compulsion]
Name: Anaesthetize
Effect: This Compulsion Alchemy causes the target to fall into a deep sleep preventing them from moving or using any Skills. The target will lie down wherever they are as soon as it is safe to do so. The target is not aware of their surroundings and is not considered Conscious. This Alchemy is removed by any effect which removes Compulsion or Poisons.

Title: Antidote
Name: Antidote
Effect: This Alchemy removes all effects which were delivered as Poison(-Strike) which are currently affecting the target.

Title: Armour Patch
Name: Armour Patch
Effect: This Alchemy instantly Refits any Physical Armour worn by the target to its full value.

Title: Berserk
Name: Berserk
Effect: This Alchemy forces the Character into an insane killing frenzy forcing them to attack everyone around them to the best of their Player's ability using the most effective means at their disposal. This means that the Character's morals or personality have no impact on the means they use to attack those around them.

Title: Binding Agent [Binding]
Name: Binding Agent
Effect: This Binding Alchemy forces the target's arms to their sides and keeps them there throughout its duration. The creature cannot use any Skill which requires the use of their arms such as using weapons or casting Spells.

Title: Cause Critical Damage
Name: Cause Critical Damage
Effect: This Alchemy causes thirty(30) points of Poison Body damage to the target.

Title: Cause Damage
Name: Cause Damage
Effect: This Alchemy causes ten(10) points of Poison Body damage to the target.

Title: Cause Mortal Damage
Name: Cause Mortal Damage
Effect: This Alchemy causes forty(40) points of Poison Body damage to the target.

Title: Cause Serious Damage
Name: Cause Serious Damage
Effect: This Alchemy causes twenty(20) points of Poison Body damage to the target.

Title: Choking Vapours [Compulsion]
Name: Choking Vapours
Effect: This Compulsion Alchemy prevents the target from speaking or casting Spells with an Incantation. Additionally, the target cannot intentionally create any sound such as clapping or using a noise making tool.

Title: Coagulant
Name: Coagulant
Effect: This Alchemy grants the Caster the ability to deliver a "Poison Stabilise" by Touch at will. The Caster may continue delivering this effect until they die or cast another Alchemy. Each individual casting of the Touch effect is subject to Disruption. Stabilise instantly puts a target which is Bleeding Out to zero(0) Hit Points.

Title: Cure Critical Damage
Name: Cure Critical Damage
Effect: This Alchemy causes thirty(30) points of Poison Healing to the target. Any healing above the Character's maximum is lost.

Title: Cure Damage
Name: Cure Damage
Effect: This Alchemy causes ten(10) points of Poison Healing to the target. Any healing above the Character's maximum is lost.

Title: Cure Mortal Damage
Name: Cure Mortal Damage
Effect: This Alchemy causes forty(40) points of Poison Healing to the target. Any healing above the Character's maximum is lost.

Title: Cure Serious Damage
Name: Cure Serious Damage
Effect: This Alchemy causes twenty(20) points of Poison Healing to the target. Any healing above the Character's maximum is lost.

Title: Disinfect
Name: Disinfect
Effect: This Alchemy grants the target a Ward allowing them to negate a single effect delivered as Poison(-Strike) by which they are struck. The target chooses when to activate this ability.

Title: Disintegoo
Name: Disintegoo
Effect: This Alchemy Destroys the target item. A Destroyed item cannot be Repaired. Certain creatures, such as Constructs, may be damaged by this Alchemy. If the target has multiple items in their possession which match the description of the item designated by the Caster it is the target who chooses which of their items are affected. The target cannot choose an item which is Indestructible unless it is the only item they have which matches that description.

Title: Dissolve
Name: Dissolve
Effect: This Alchemy Breaks the item designated by the Caster rendering it unusable until it is Repaired. If the target has multiple items in their possession which match the description of the item designated by the Caster it is the target who chooses which of their items are affected. The target cannot choose an item which is Indestructible unless it is the only item they have which matches that description. Certain creatures, such as Constructs, may be damaged by this Alchemy.

Title: Distracting Fumes [Compulsion]
Name: Distracting Fumes
Effect: This Compulsion Alchemy prevents the target from willingly approaching the Caster or attacking the Caster. This effect ends if the Caster attacks the target.

Title: Dominate [Compulsion]
Name: Dominate
Effect: This Compulsion Alchemy places the target under the complete control of the Caster. They will follow all orders, even self destructive ones. Please note that this Alchemy does not force a Player to engage in any activities they are not comfortable with performing.

Title: Elixir of Death/Life
Name: Elixir of Death/Life
Effect: As part of casting this Spell the Caster chooses one of the following options; Death or Life. This Alchemy allows the Caster to deliver the chosen effect as a packet attack.

Title: Explosive Concoction
Name: Explosive Concoction
Effect: As part of casting this Spell the Caster chooses one of the following options; Acid or Fire. This Alchemy allows the Caster to deliver a packet attack causing fifty(50) points of Poison damage of the chosen type.

Title: Fortifying Elixir
Name: Fortifying Elixir
Effect: This Alchemy grants the target five(5) Fortification Points. These Fortification Points are always the first lost due to damage. Multiple effects which grant Fortification Points do not stack.

Title: Glue [Curse]
Name: Glue
Effect: This Curse Alchemy prevents the target from running or jumping. The target must have at least one foot on the ground at all times and cannot move faster than a normal walking pace.

Title: Hallucinogen
Name: Hallucinogen
Effect: This Alchemy prevents the target from running or even standing up right. The target cannot use any Skills and, additionally, cannot move without crawling. This Alchemy lasts ten(10) seconds.

Title: Herbicide
Name: Herbicide
Effect: This Alchemy instantly Vanquishes the target Plant Type Creature. A Vanquished creature instantly begins Bleeding Out. Some powerful Plant creatures may instead take damage from this Alchemy.

Title: Insecticide
Name: Insecticide
Effect: This Alchemy instantly Vanquishes the target Insectoid Type Creature. A Vanquished creature instantly begins Bleeding Out. Some powerful Insectoids may instead take damage from this Alchemy.

Title: Jellyflesh [Curse]
Name: Jellyflesh
Effect: As part of casting this Alchemy the Caster may choose a limb such as left arm, left leg, right arm, right leg. This Alchemy prevents the target from using the chosen limb. A Crippled arm cannot be used to use any item or cast Spells. A Crippled leg prevents the target from walking, forcing them to kneel. Alternatively, this Alchemy may be used to remove all Cripple effects from the target regardless of Delivery Type.

Title: Liquid Light
Name: Liquid Light
Effect: This Spell creates an Alchemical Light source which allows the use of a diffused flash light, lantern, glow stick or similar light source. A light source may be disqualified from use if it is too bright. The decision as to whether or not a light can be used is up to the Marshal.

Title: Noxious Fumes [Compulsion]
Name: Noxious Fumes
Effect: This Compulsion Alchemy affects the target with a "Poison Shun" effect preventing the target from willingly approaching the Caster or attacking the Caster. This effect ends if the Caster attacks the target.

Title: Oil of Escaping
Name: Oil of Escaping
Effect: This effect removes all Binding effects from the target. Additionally, this effect frees the target from any form of mundane confinement including, but not limited to; rope, manacles and stocks.

Title: Oil of Slipperiness [Curse]
Name: Oil of Slipperiness
Effect: This Curse Alchemy prevents the target from using a single weapon chosen by the Caster, or using any Skill requiring the use of the weapon for its duration. If the target is wielding more than one weapon which matches the description named by the Caster it us up to the target which weapon is affected.

Title: Ooze Shell
Name: Ooze Shell
Effect: This Alchemy grants the target a Shield against the next effect causing Weapon Damage, or which is delivered as Physical(-Strike), by which they are struck.

Title: Painkiller
Name: Painkiller
Effect: This Alchemy removes all effects delivered as Physical(-Strike) from the target.

Title: Paste of Stickiness [Binding]
Name: Paste of Stickiness
Effect: This Binding Alchemy immobilises the target preventing them from moving or using any Skills while in effect. Additionally, the target cannot be moved.

Title: Pin Flask [Binding]
Name: Pin Flask
Effect: This Binding Alchemy prevents the target from moving their right foot from its position at the time they are affected by this effect. The target may pivot on this foot but can neither lift, nor move it.

Title: Quicksilver
Name: Quicksilver
Effect: This Alchemy allows the target to use the Weapon Type: Silver against a single target until the end of combat.

Title: Slime Shroud
Name: Slime Shroud
Effect: This Alchemy grants the target a Ward allowing them to negate a single effect causing Weapon Damage, or delivered as Physical(-Strike), by which they are struck. The target chooses when to activate this ability. When activated, this Alchemy also instantly restores any Physical Armour the Caster possesses to full value. The call for this effect is "Ward, Poison Refit Physical Armour".

Title: Smelling Salts
Name: Smelling Salts
Effect: This Alchemy instantly removes all Compulsions effects from the target. The following effects are Compulsions; Calm, Charm, Dominate, Fear, Shun, Silence, Sleep. This Spell does not affect Enthral.

Title: Stimulant
Name: Stimulant
Effect: This Alchemy grants the target a single use of the Dodge Skill, allowing them to avoid a single effect, delivered by weapon or packet.

Title: Toxin [Curse]
Name: Toxin
Effect: This Curse Alchemy prevents the target from running or using any Skills until the effect ends or is removed.

Title: Toxin Flush
Name: Toxin Flush
Effect: This Alchemy instantly removes all harmful effects from the target which would be removed by the target becoming Dead as well as Enthral. The target's Player makes the determination as to which effects are harmful.

Title: Tranquillise [Compulsion]
Name: Tranquillise
Effect: This Compulsion Alchemy causes the target to enter an extremely calm and tranquil state. The target cannot attack themselves or any other creature though they will not ignore danger. This effect ends if the target is attacked.

Title: UnParalytic [Curse]
Name: UnParalytic
Effect: This Alchemy allows the Caster to deliver either a "Poison Paralysis" effect or a "Poison Remove Paralysis" effect.

Title: Vaccine
Name: Vaccine
Effect: This Alchemy grants the target a Shield against the next effect delivered as Poison(-Strike) by which they are struck.

Title: Vertigo
Name: Vertigo
Effect: This Alchemy prevents the target from running or even standing up right. The target cannot use any Skills and, additionally, can neither walk, nor run, being restricted to crawling for movement.

Title: Vorpal Coating
Name: Vorpal Coating
Effect: This Alchemy grants the target the ability to cause five(5) additional points of damage with their next weapon attack. The target can continue calling this bonus damage until they successfully land a valid strike on their target.

Title: Vorpal Coating, Greater
Name: Vorpal Coating, Greater
Effect: This Alchemy grants the target the ability to cause five(5) additional points of damage with their next three(3) weapon attacks. The target can continue calling this bonus damage until they successfully land a valid strike on their target.

Title: Vorpal Coating, Superior
Name: Vorpal Coating, Superior
Effect: This Alchemy grants the target the ability to cause five(5) additional points of damage with their next five(5) weapon attacks. The target can continue calling this bonus damage until they successfully land a valid strike on their target.

Title: Weakening Gas [Curse]
Name: Weakening Gas
Effect: This Alchemy prevents the target from using Martial Arts with a Range of Strike, and Skills requiring the use of weapons, except Weapon Proficiencies. The target may still cast Spells which are delivered as <Delivery Type>-Strike.

Title: Web Flask [Binding]
Name: Web Flask
Effect: This Binding Alchemy forces the victim's arms to their sides and renders them unable to move or be moved. This also prevents the target from using any Skills, requiring the use of their hands or arms, while under its effects. The target may still speak.
